_about: The moving checklist (moved_house) on the same ledgers, as secretary/moving.py writes it and as the static demo's mock (web/src/mocks/moving.ts) ports it: the registration row, each sender with a running contract, and the broadcasting fee office. Read by tests/test_moving.py and web/src/mocks/moving.test.ts. Fictional data.

cases.name: a move last week: registration ahead, the broadcasting fee office, then each sender with a running contract

rows.title: Register your new address by Thu 8 Oct
rows.body: Register at the citizens' office (Bürgeramt or Einwohnermeldeamt) where you now live, within two weeks of moving in. Take your ID card or passport and your landlord's confirmation that you moved in (Wohnungsgeberbestätigung) — ask your landlord for it. Appointments are often booked out, so book one soon.
rows.rationale: You moved in on Thu 24 Sep; registering is due within two weeks (§ 17 Abs. 1 BMG).

action.label: Tick it off once you're registered

rows.title: Tell the broadcasting fee office your new address
rows.body: If you pay the broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag) for your flat, change your address online at rundfunkbeitrag.de. If you moved in with someone who already pays, you can de-register instead.
rows.rationale: You moved in on Thu 24 Sep.

action.label: Tick it off once it's changed

rows.title: Tell Muster Tech your new address
rows.body: Your contracts “Company pension”, “Job ticket” and 1 more with them are running. Tell HR or payroll: your payslips and tax papers go there.
rows.rationale: You moved in on Thu 24 Sep.

rows.title: Tell Musterbank your new address
rows.body: Your contract “Musterbank Girokonto” with them is running. Many banks let you change it in online banking.
rows.rationale: You moved in on Thu 24 Sep.

rows.title: Tell FitWell your new address
rows.body: Your contract “FitWell Flex” with them is running.
rows.rationale: You moved in on Thu 24 Sep.

rows.title: Tell Stadtwerke Muster your new address
rows.body: Your contract “MusterStrom Natur” with them is running. Note your meter readings on the day you move out and send them in.
rows.rationale: You moved in on Thu 24 Sep.
